# COLDWAR | nasser_health
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_EGY.9
	title = COLDWAR_EGY.9.t
	desc = COLDWAR_EGY.9.d
	picture = GFX_hospital

	# repeats every year or so while the ailing Nasser lives
	trigger = {
		original_tag = EGY
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EGY_nasser_ailing
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = { days = 365 }

	immediate = {
		random_list = {
			75 = { add_stability = -0.01 }
			25 = { COLDWAR_EGY_nasser_dies = yes }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_EGY.9.a
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

		original_tag = EGY

	}
